ocr.title: Recognition Result

ocr.regionTitle: Drag to select a region and OCR only that area
ocr.regionHint: Drag to select the area to recognize, release to OCR
ocr.langTitle: Recognition language (auto / 中文 / English / 日本語; forced on Windows, auto on macOS)
ocr.exportTitle: Export the recognition result as a .txt / .md file
ocr.rerunTitle: Re-recognize using the same image (keeps current language)

ocr.exportFmtTitle: Choose the export format: Text / Markdown / JSON with coords / TSV with coords
ocr.resetEditsTitle: Discard manual corrections and restore original recognized text
ocr.confHidden: Hidden {n} low-confidence line(s); lower the threshold to show
ocr.copyMergeTitle: Remove line breaks when copying/exporting, join with spaces
ocr.lineEditTitle: Click a line to correct the recognized text
ocr.batchEmpty: No recognizable text from the selected screenshots
ocr.layoutReadingTitle: Reorder reading sequence by coordinates for multi-column/vertical captures (off by default, preserves original order)
ocr.autoCopyTitle: Automatically copy text to clipboard after recognition (off by default to avoid overwriting)
ocr.multiRegionTitle: Keep selection mode on after each region OCR so you can box multiple separate regions and accumulate them
ocr.historyReplayTitle: Jump back to this screenshot and re-open the OCR result
ocr.selLineTitle: Select to include only this line in copy / export / paste
ocr.selAllTitle: Select / clear all visible lines (precise extraction)
ocr.previewTitle: Colored boxes mark where each line was found; hover/click a box or a list row to locate it
ocr.clipTitle: Read text or an image from the system clipboard and extract its text: text is used directly, images are OCR-recognized (from browser / WeChat / any other tool)
ocr.clipEmpty: No image found on the clipboard
ocr.clipNotImage: The clipboard contains text, not an image — copy an image first
ocr.clipNoImgFile: No recognizable image file on the clipboard (you may have copied a folder or a non-image file)
ocr.clipBadImgFile: The file on the clipboard is not a valid image and cannot be recognized
ocr.clipZero: The clipboard image has zero size and cannot be recognized
ocr.clipEmptyNeutral: The clipboard is empty — copy an image or some text first
ocr.clipTextOnly: The clipboard only contains blank text — copy an image or valid text
ocr.clipRereadTitle: Re-read the system clipboard (pick up freshly copied content)
ocr.extractTitle: One-tap extract URLs, emails and phone numbers from the result for individual copy
ocr.cleanTitle: Safely normalize on copy/export: full→half width, strip spaces between CJK chars, collapse extra whitespace (no character guessing)
ocr.noEntity: No links, emails or phone numbers detected
ocr.regionPickTitle: Drag a box on the preview to extract only the text blocks inside it
ocr.regionPickActive: Drag on the preview to select the area to extract…
ocr.regionPickNone: No text blocks in that area
ocr.copyJsonTitle: Copy as coordinate-bearing JSON text (no file)
ocr.copyTsvTitle: Copy as coordinate-bearing TSV text (no file)
ocr.redactSelTitle: Redact (mosaic) the checked / box-selected / text-selected blocks
ocr.highlightSelTitle: Add a highlight background to the checked / box-selected / text-selected blocks
ocr.arrowSelTitle: Draw an arrow from the left edge pointing at the checked / box-selected / text-selected blocks
ocr.selNeeded: Select text blocks first in the preview, list, or full text
ocr.batchAiRunning: Processing selected screenshots one by one…
ocr.batchAiEmpty2: Enter an instruction and click "Run batch AI" to run the same task on every selected screenshot
ocr.batchAiPrompt: Instruction applied to every selected screenshot (e.g. extract all button labels and translate to English)
ocr.batchAiNoKey: Configure an API key in AI settings first

result.title: Capture Complete
result.ocrTitle: Recognize text from this capture (open editor and OCR)

permission.title: Screen Recording Permission Required
permission.dev2: with a complete .app bundle, so it can request screen recording like the release build. Click “Full Screen Capture” once and the system will prompt (allow it), or open System Settings below, find
permission.dev3: turn it on, then click “Authorized? Refresh”.
permission.normal1: needs Screen Recording permission to capture the screen. Click the button below to open System Settings, find
permission.normal2: in the list, turn it on, then return and click “Authorized? Refresh”.

screenRecording.title: Screen Recording Permission
screenRecording.missing: Screen Recording permission not granted. SnapCraft cannot capture screenshots until you allow it.
screenRecording.howTo:
1) Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording
2) Toggle on “{brand}”
3) Return here and click “Refresh”
screenRecording.required: Required for: full screen, region, window, and scrolling capture

microphone.title: Microphone Permission
microphone.notRequired: Not required in this version. SnapCraft does not record audio.
microphone.future: Will be required in a future version for screen recording with audio.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Permission
accessibility.notRequired: Not required in this version. Global hotkeys work without it.
accessibility.future: Will be required in a future version for advanced global hotkey features.

filesAndFolders.title: Files and Folders
filesAndFolders.downloads: Download folder: SnapCraft saves screenshots to ~/Downloads by default. Access granted automatically through the App Sandbox.
filesAndFolders.desktop: Desktop folder: Access granted automatically when you save a screenshot there.
filesAndFolders.pictures: Pictures folder: Access granted automatically when you save a screenshot there.

fullDisk.title: Full Disk Access
fullDisk.notRequired: Not required. SnapCraft only accesses folders you explicitly grant.

troubleshooting.title: Permission Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.stillMissing: If the toggle is already on but SnapCraft still cannot capture, try:
troubleshooting.step1: 1) Toggle Screen Recording OFF, wait 5 seconds, toggle ON again
troubleshooting.step2: 2) Quit SnapCraft completely (Cmd + Q) and reopen
troubleshooting.step3: 3) Restart your Mac if the issue persists
troubleshooting.resetSuccess: All SnapCraft permissions reset. The next capture will re-prompt for authorization.

display.title: Choose a display to capture
display.text: Detected {n} display(s), arranged by physical position (left→right). Click the matching one below.

toast.granted: Permission granted. You can start capturing.
toast.notGranted: Still no permission detected. Please enable it in System Settings.
toast.frameCaptured: Captured 1 frame. Scroll then capture more.
toast.stitchGap: Some adjacent frames didn't overlap; joined directly (possible gap).
toast.stitched: Stitched {n} frames into a long image
toast.savedWithReveal: Saved to {path} · click to reveal in Finder
toast.pinned: Pinned to screen (double-click / Esc to close)

pin.title: Drag to move · double-click / Esc to close

overlay.regionHint: Drag to select a region · right-click / Esc to cancel
overlay.windowHint: Hover a window to highlight, then click · right-click / Esc to cancel

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.welcomeDesc: Configure your AI API (OpenAI / Claude / DeepSeek etc.) before use
ai.goalPh: e.g. Turn this screenshot into a product documentation
ai.agentGoalPh: e.g. Outline the error log area and label it, then write a troubleshooting note
ai.sentinelGoalPh: Leave empty to scan & redact the whole image; or specify e.g. 'only redact the amount and name at top-right'
ai.attachImageTitle: Send the current screenshot to the model (requires a vision-capable model)
ai.attachImageAgentTitle: AI Smart Edit / Privacy Sentinel must see the screenshot to edit by coordinates, so it is attached automatically (cannot be turned off)
ai.confirmRegenerate: You have an existing conversation. Generating will clear it and start fresh. Continue?
ai.visionImageTitle: The AI sees your edited screenshot (with annotations/redactions); click to re-composite the latest changes before sending to the AI
ai.attachOcrTitle: Send the OCR-recognized text as additional context
ai.agentModeDesc: When on, AI can directly call tools to edit the current screenshot (outline / redact / highlight / OCR) and produce a document. AI provides coordinates as 0~1 relative ratios.
ai.sentinelModeDesc: When on, AI scans the current screenshot for all sensitive info (phone / email / ID / bank card / password / key / address, etc.) and redacts each, then lists redactions and residual risk. Only calls redact_area, no boxes.
ai.sentinelDefaultGoal: Scan the whole image, identify and redact all sensitive information (phone, email, ID/passport, bank card, password, API key, detailed address, real name, amounts, etc.). When unsure, redact anyway.
ai.shapedHint: Detected that this model did not emit native tool_calls; tool calls were auto-extracted from text (supports JSON fenced / XML / Bracketed / ReAct).
ai.popupPinTitle: When pinned, this big window pops up on every stream
ai.copyRichTitle: Copy the rendered HTML to the clipboard so structure (headings, lists, tables, quotes) is preserved when pasting into Word / email / rich editors, instead of raw Markdown source
ai.exportRevealTitle: Open the file's containing folder in the system file manager
ai.openAppTitle: Open the file with the system default app (e.g. Word for .docx, Keynote for .pptx)
ai.historyConfirmDelete: Delete this AI conversation history? This cannot be undone.
ai.historyConfirmDeleteBody: This will permanently remove the conversation, memories, and result thumbnail.
ai.exportPptxTitle: Export as PowerPoint slides (split by headings; text-only deck)
ai.exportPdfHint: System print dialog opened — choose “Save as PDF” to export
ai.exportXlsxTitle: Export as Excel spreadsheet (best for tabular/data content; pair with the "Extract table" preset to turn screenshot data into an editable sheet)
ai.exportZipTitle: Package the session as a zip archive (includes the doc md, raw transcript json, source image and README — portable and shareable)
ai.previewTitle: Preview the document in a new tab without downloading first
ai.previewBlocked: Preview blocked by the browser. Allow pop-ups and retry, or just download to view
ai.attachMoreDesc: Select several screenshots from history; the AI will analyze them together into one complete document.
ai.makeReportTitle: Compose multiple screenshots (current + attached) in selection order into one illustrated report
ai.editTitle: Edit the generated content in-place (Markdown source); on Done it is written back and reused for re-export
ai.editHint: Edit the document (Markdown source). Click Done so that subsequent export / copy / preview use the edited version.
ai.orderDrag: Drag or use arrows to reorder chapters
ai.templateDescPh: e.g. A one-line description for this template (optional)
ai.templateInstructionPh: e.g. Write a structured PRD from the screenshot, with background, features, acceptance criteria…
ai.templateEmpty: No custom templates yet. Tap "Add" to create your own generation mode.
ai.applyTitle: Paste the AI copy onto the screenshot as an editable text annotation (move/edit/restyle after)
ai.errorNoKey: Please fill in the API Key in "API Settings" first
ai.errorAuth: API key is invalid or unauthorized (401/403). Please check the Key in "API Settings".
ai.errorRateLimit: Too many requests (429). Please wait a few seconds and retry.
ai.errorServer: Server error (5xx). Please retry later or check the API base URL.
ai.errorContext: Content exceeds the model context length. Please shorten the prompt or attach fewer screenshots.
ai.chatEmpty: After generating the first draft, keep the conversation going here to refine it into a complete document or copy.
ai.chatPlaceholder: Follow up, e.g. make section 2 more detailed, or add a conclusion

preset.summaryDesc: Generate a work summary / weekly report
preset.bulletDesc: Extract key points as a list
preset.bugDesc: Turn a screenshot into a structured bug report
preset.prdDesc: Turn a screenshot into a product requirements doc
preset.competeDesc: Turn a screenshot into a competitive analysis
preset.meetingDesc: Turn a screenshot into meeting notes / action items
preset.insightDesc: Turn a chart screenshot into data insights
preset.reportDesc: Compose multiple screenshots into one illustrated report
preset.tableDesc: Extract screenshot data/table into an editable Excel

ai.memCompactTitle: Summarize the earliest rounds into long-term memory to avoid an over-long context
ai.memEditTitle: Edit this memory's summary and importance
ai.memDeleteTitle: Delete this memory (remove sensitive info here)
ai.historyLoaded: Loaded into the panel; keep asking below to refine it
ai.historyEmpty: No AI documents yet. After you generate a doc or copy, each one is saved here (bucketed by screenshot) so you can revisit or keep refining it anytime.
ai.historyNoResult: No matching documents. Try another keyword.
ai.historyForkTitle: Copy the whole conversation as a new branch and load it, so you can explore a different direction without altering the original
ai.historyForked: Forked as a new branch and loaded; keep asking freely
ai.historyForkFromTitle: Truncate at this AI reply and copy the first half as a new branch to continue from
